| A-120 | P02 | ADR-011, ADR-019 | Browser upload PUTs to a presigned S3 URL, but the CSP has `connect-src 'self'` and the bucket needs CORS | CSP `connect-src` adds the configured public S3 origin (`QL_S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT_URL`); bucket CORS allows only the web origin, PUT only; no upload proxy | open |
| A-121 | P02 | §6.7, ARCHITECTURE §8.3 | `import_batches` has no column for the uploaded file key or its header columns, and the preview lives in object storage | `meta.json` (source key, extension, header columns) and `preview.json` are stored under `t/{tenant}/import/{batch}/` in the private files bucket, never served by a presigned URL; no schema change | open |
| A-122 | P02 | ADR-008, ADR-006 | Dramatiq's dead-worker maintenance calls Redis `KEYS`, which the app ACL user denies (workers stop consuming after a restart) | Separate worker ACL user | decided by human 2026-10-03: separate ACL user `qualloop_worker` (same key patterns, plus KEYS) for Dramatiq consumers only; API, dispatcher and scheduler keep `qualloop_app` (ADR-008 amendment) |
